calls.prompt:
You write realistic customer-support messages for testing a router.

Write 20 different messages, 1-3 sentences each (longer if the style asks for it), in a customer's own voice, varied in tone and detail. Never use the words of the description literally.
Style: different from training: hurried mobile messages, non-native phrasing, or long detailed complaints, mixed

The customer's situation: their order has not arrived; it is late or lost in transit. They describe it plainly.

Answer with JSON only: {"messages": ["...", ...]}

messages: Hi, the delivery date was yesterday and there’s still nothing at my door. Could you check what’s going on?
Hey, quick one — tracking hasn’t moved since Monday and I’m still waiting for the parcel.
I was expecting this last week. The tracking page keeps showing the same depot scan, so I’m not sure if it’s coming.
Nothing has turned up yet, and I’ve checked with the neighbors too. Can you help me find out where it is?
Sorry, typing on my phone: parcel still not here. Tracking says “in transit” for 6 days now.
The courier texted that it would arrive today, but nobody came and there’s no delivery photo. What should I do?
I placed this quite a while ago and the tracking seems stuck. Could you please look into it and let me know the next steps?
Hello, I think my package may have gone missing. It hasn’t had a tracking update in over a week.
Any update on this? The expected date passed, but the tracking still only says it’s on the way.
I’m a little frustrated because I needed this for a birthday yesterday. There’s been no sign of the parcel, even though the tracking says it left the sorting center.
Hi! Maybe I’m reading the tracking wrong, but it says the package is moving and hasn’t changed since the 12th. Is that normal?
This is the second time I’ve contacted you. The parcel still hasn’t arrived, and the carrier hasn’t updated its location since last Thursday.
Could someone check this shipment for me? The delivery window has passed, and I can’t tell whether it’s delayed or stuck somewhere.
I’ve waited patiently, but at this point I don’t know if the parcel is still coming. Please tell me what you can see on your end.
Hey, it was meant to come two days ago. Nothing outside, nothing with reception, and the tracking page is no help.
My tracking number hasn’t changed from “departed facility” in nine days. I’d appreciate an actual update rather than another estimated date.
Good afternoon. I have not received the parcel, and the carrier’s website has shown the same status for several days. Would you please investigate?
It’s been nearly three weeks since I ordered, and there’s still no package. Can you confirm whether it’s been misplaced?
Hi, I’m traveling soon and was counting on this arriving before I leave. It hasn’t shown up, and the last scan was over a week ago.
Just checking in — the delivery date keeps shifting and now there’s no new estimate. Can you find out where my parcel is?
